raw_text:
Rust Titan Exchange WebSocket client: streaming/one-shot quotes, reconnect, queued streams, Solana instructions; library plus optional CLI.

Commands:
cargo build --release
cargo run --features cli --bin titan-cli -- --help
cargo run --features cli --bin titan-cli -- info
cargo run --features cli --bin titan-cli -- price SOL USDC 1000000000
cargo run --features cli --bin titan-cli -- stream SOL USDC 1000000000
cargo run --features cli --bin titan-cli -- swap --keypair ~/.config/solana/id.json SOL USDC 100000000
cargo run --features cli --bin titan-cli -- watch
cargo test --test [name]
cargo clippy --all-targets

Architecture: `TitanClient` shares an Arc-backed connection across handlers. Background tokio task dispatches WebSocket frames and reconnects with exponential backoff. `StreamManager` queues requests at the concurrency limit. `active_count` slots have an `Arc<AtomicBool>` (`slot_released`) guard against double release on stop/Drop, server `StreamEnd`, or reconnection failure; `ResumableStream.on_end` connects server endings to queue accounting. Reconnection updates `effective_stream_id: Arc<AtomicU32>` for subsequent `StopStream`.

Files: `src/lib.rs` exports; `src/client.rs` API; `src/config.rs` settings; `src/connection.rs` keepalive/resumption; `src/error.rs` errors; `src/state.rs` observable state; `src/stream.rs` handles; `src/queue.rs` concurrency; `src/instructions.rs` Solana conversion/ALTs; `src/tls.rs` secure/dev TLS; `src/bin/titan_cli.rs` CLI. `FOR_USER.md` has architectural background.

CLI environment: `TITAN_URL` (CLI default `wss://us1.api.demo.titan.exchange/api/v1/ws`; library default `wss://api.titan.ag/api/v1/ws`), `TITAN_TOKEN` (required), `SOLANA_RPC_URL` (default `https://api.mainnet-beta.solana.com`), `TITAN_DANGER_ACCEPT_INVALID_CERTS` (dev only). Config defaults: reconnect ceiling 30,000 ms; attempts unlimited; auto-wrap SOL false; invalid cert acceptance false; one-shot timeout 10,000 ms; ping/pong use connection defaults.

API: `new_swap_quote_stream`, `get_swap_price` (first quote, auto-stop), `get_swap_price_simple`, `get_info`, `get_venues`, `list_providers`, `state`, `state_receiver`, `is_connected`, `wait_for_connected`, `close`, `is_closed`, `active_stream_count`, `queued_stream_count`. `TitanInstructions` provides `prepare_instructions`, `fetch_address_lookup_tables`, `convert_instructions`, `convert_instruction`.

The streaming endpoint may send initial `SwapQuotes` frames with empty `quotes` vector before real data arrives, especially with dummy user pubkeys. Tests should not assert `!quotes.quotes.is_empty()` unless using a real wallet address.

**Maximum file size: ~200 lines** - Split larger files
**mod.rs files should be empty** - Only contain mod declarations, move content to meaningful file names
Use helper structs with static methods for clear separation (e.g., `TitanHelper::method()`)
Single error enum for the crate (`TitanClientError`)
All fallible operations return `Result`
**Never panic** - Always propagate errors via Result
Use typed variants for recoverable errors (auth, rate limit), anyhow for unexpected
Use native `async fn` directly
No boxed futures or `async-trait` unless absolutely necessary
Tokio-only (no runtime-agnostic abstractions)
Use `pub` everywhere for simplicity
Use `#[tracing::instrument(skip_all)]` on public methods
**No inline log statements** - Spans provide enough context
Remove `println!`, `dbg!`, and most `tracing::info!` statements
Keep only `tracing::error!` and `tracing::warn!` for critical issues
Minimal doc comments
Only document non-obvious behavior
Let names and types be self-documenting
Consolidate all constants into central location or `constants.rs`
Remove magic numbers from inline code
Re-export `titan-api-types` types directly (no wrapper types)
Enable Solana conversion features for seamless integration

Features: `solana` default; `cli` optional. `docs.rs` builds with `default-features = false` to avoid Solana deps timeout.
